messages:
maria: Quick sync about Dedicated GA: we need a short PRD for reserved pools + burst rules to share with sales and SRE. Main tradeoffs: contiguous bursts vs flexible ledger, carryover policy, and telemetry needs.

kenji: Agreed. Recommend contiguous 5m windows for GA (simpler for admissions), no carryover unless contracted.

product_lead: +1. Keep GA simple. Pilot customers can get contract options.

sarah: Runtime note: cold KV/cache warmup can add ~100ms p95 on first tokens. If bursts start immediately, include prewarm credits or model-fallback behavior in PRD.

ralph: Ops asks: every soft-eviction emits structured event with tenant_id, pool_id, reason, active_requests. Also need manual override that logs operator and duration.

ops-bot: /event-schema created: soft_eviction_v1 -> tenant_id,pool_id,ts,reason,active_requests:int,fallback_model :white_check_mark:

maria: Telemetry: minimal set: dedicated.burst_seconds{tenant,pool}, dedicated.latency_p95{tenant,pool}, dedicated.evictions_total{tenant,pool,reason}. Retention: 30d hist, 90d percentiles. Export daily snapshot to BigQuery.

kenji: I'll own telemetry pipeline. Will support BigQuery export + CSV fallback. Watch cardinality (10k tenant labels cap).

devex: Console UX must show active burst window, warning banners, and a 7-day burst timeline per tenant. Also link to retry/backoff guidance.

sam_cs: CS request: include customer-facing blurb explaining 429 + fallback payload and recommended backoffs (exponential jitter).

maria: Canary plan: 5% reserved-pool traffic for 48h, measure p95, eviction rate, and autoscale oscillation. Acceptance: p95 delta <5% for top 10 tenants; evictions_rate <0.5% sustained.

product_lead: Add contingency: if canary fails, rollback and run postmortem before next attempt.

maria: OK I'll draft PRD with owners: telemetry=kenji, runtime= s sarah, ops=ralph, console=devex, cs content=sam_cs. Target: feature flags end of sprint (2w), GA ~6w if canary green.

kenji: noted. Posting a tiny autoscale config sample for the PRD:
```
autoscale:
  queue_threshold: 200
  sustained_window_s: 60
  cooldown_s: 120
```

ralph: Also define alerting: P1 if evictions_rate >0.5% for 10m on any pool; P2 if telemetry export fails >5m.

maria: Thanks. I'll share PRD draft by EOD for review.
